CLEAR TO TRADE / ROUND A

Journey & first vertical slice
Internal review · synthetic data · not bank-approved policy
DEMO-CTT-001 · en-AU · Case revision 1 · IA v0.4 / D2 v0.1

Five reading stages: S1 Initiate & scope / S2 Determine & source / S3 Screen & assess / S4 Assure & resolve / S5 Clear to trade

Both Current and Target are printed for all six authored scenarios, including content outside the screen viewport. Nine additional scenarios are listed as structural scope.

01 · SCN-REQUIREMENTS · S2 · M2.1–M2.5
Make requirements explicit
Current

Determine AML and non-AML requirements, exceptions and risk indicators for the relationship.

Target

Prepare a versioned requirement set. Show the subject, purpose and basis of each requirement; retain unknown applicability.

Wait / input: Scope and policy context must be known. Exceptions require a designated reviewer.

Human boundary: Confirm the demo requirement set. No client policy is inferred.

Expected result: Requirements confirmed for this synthetic scope; evidence still needs assessment.

SRC-007 · M2.1–M2.5 / SRC-010 §6 · Design hypothesis + synthetic record · J-M2-01

02 · SCN-SOURCE · S2 · M3.1–M3.2
Use evidence already available
Current

Search public and commercial sources, then identify residual gaps. This already exists in the Current map.

Target

Link a source item to a specific subject, requirement and purpose, with its original version intact.

Wait / input: Access permission, source provenance and purpose-specific sufficiency.

Human boundary: Review proposed reuse. One accepted file does not satisfy every requirement.

Expected result: Entity identity may be supported; screening disambiguation remains a separate use.

SRC-007 · M3.1–M3.2 / SRC-010 §6 · Design hypothesis + synthetic record · J-M3-01

03 · SCN-GAP · S2 · M2.5 · M3.2–M3.3
Ask only for remaining gaps
Current

Issue requirements and request outstanding information from the client.

Target

Consolidate only unresolved facts into a purpose-specific request, with an owner and response link.

Wait / input: A permitted sender confirms the request; the review then waits for the named response.

Human boundary: Review the missing fact, purpose and response owner before simulating release.

Expected result: Request recorded locally. No email is sent. Receipt returns evidence to review.

SRC-007 · M2.5 · M3.2–M3.3 / SRC-010 §6 · Design hypothesis + synthetic record · J-M3-02, J-M3-03

04 · SCN-VALIDATE · S2 · M3.4–M3.5
Assess evidence for its purpose
Current

Capture and validate evidence; maintain outstanding gaps and the sourcing trail.

Target

Keep the artifact and its use assessment separate. A received supplement needs its own reviewed assessment.

Wait / input: The received supplement and a reasoned sufficiency assessment for the screening purpose.

Human boundary: A configured demo reviewer records sufficiency with rationale; bank authority remains open.

Expected result: Evidence use assessed. Screening still requires a separate human disposition.

SRC-007 · M3.4–M3.5 / SRC-010 §6 · Design hypothesis + synthetic record · J-M3-04

05 · SCN-MATCH · S3 · M4.5–M4.7
Resolve a possible match
Current

Adjudicate possible hits, assess materiality and record the screening outcome.

Target

Prepare subject-to-record comparisons and evidence-use links. A human records the disposition or requests more information.

Wait / input: Sufficient current evidence, rationale and explicit simulated authority. Similarity is not a decision.

Human boundary: Only the demo reviewer may record disposition. No autonomous approval or automatic EDD.

Expected result: This finding is resolved for its input version. Legal, Credit and final QA remain open.

SRC-007 · M4.5–M4.7 / SRC-010 §6 · Design hypothesis + synthetic record · SCN-MATCH

06 · SCN-READINESS · S5 · M8.1
Know exactly what remains
Current

Confirm completion of all applicable clearance prerequisites.

Target

Derive a versioned snapshot from explicit conditions, each with its own owner, reason and next action.

Wait / input: Legal execution, Credit conditions, QA review and any unresolved applicability.

Human boundary: Final bank authority is not configured. Publishing and real trades are outside this slice.

Expected result: Not ready is an explainable result, not a percentage. Authorisation and publication stay separate.

SRC-007 · M8.1 / SRC-010 §6 · Design hypothesis + synthetic record · SCN-READINESS

Additional journey structure

SCN-SCOPE / M0 · M1 — Define the relationship · Not interactive in Round A

SCN-ENTITY / M1 · M3.4 — Establish entity & authority · Not interactive in Round A

SCN-POPULATION / M4.1–M4.4 — Screen the right subjects · Not interactive in Round A

SCN-EDD / M5 — Assess elevated risk, if applicable · Not interactive in Round A

SCN-QA / M6 — Close a specific quality gap · Not interactive in Round A

SCN-CONFLICTS / M1 → M7 — Start conflicts early · Not interactive in Round A

SCN-LEGAL / C1 — Complete applicable agreements · Not interactive in Round A

SCN-CREDIT / C2 — Resolve credit conditions · Not interactive in Round A

SCN-PUBLISH / M8.2–M8.5 — Publish the scoped outcome · Not interactive in Round A

CLEAR TO TRADE / ROUND A

旅程与首个纵向切片
内部评审 · 合成数据 · 非银行已批准政策
DEMO-CTT-001 · zh-CN · 案件版本 1 · IA v0.4 / D2 v0.1

五个阅读阶段： S1 发起与界定 / S2 明确要求与取证 / S3 筛查与评估 / S4 复核与解决 / S5 交易准入

打印全部六个已编制场景的 Current 与 Target，包含屏幕之外的内容。另列九个结构场景。

01 · SCN-REQUIREMENTS · S2 · M2.1–M2.5
明确适用要求
Current

按关系范围确定 AML 与非 AML 要求、例外及风险指标。

Target

编制版本化要求集；逐项关联主体、用途和依据，保留未知适用性。

等待 / 输入: 需明确范围与政策背景；例外须交指定复核人员。

人工边界: 确认演示要求集，不据此推断客户政策。

预期结果: 仅确认本合成范围内的要求；证据仍待评估。

SRC-007 · M2.1–M2.5 / SRC-010 §6 · 设计假设 + 合成记录 · J-M2-01

02 · SCN-SOURCE · S2 · M3.1–M3.2
复用已有证据
Current

检索公开与商业来源并识别剩余缺口；Current 源图已包含这些活动。

Target

将来源资料关联到具体主体、要求和用途，保留原版本。

等待 / 输入: 等待来源许可、出处核验及特定用途的充分性判断。

人工边界: 复核拟议复用；接受一份文件不等于满足所有要求。

预期结果: 主体身份可获得支持；筛查身份区分仍是独立用途。

SRC-007 · M3.1–M3.2 / SRC-010 §6 · 设计假设 + 合成记录 · J-M3-01

03 · SCN-GAP · S2 · M2.5 · M3.2–M3.3
只询问剩余缺口
Current

发布要求并向客户请求尚缺信息。

Target

仅将未解决事实汇总为用途明确的请求，并指定责任人与响应关联。

等待 / 输入: 允许发送的角色确认请求后，复核等待指定响应。

人工边界: 模拟发出前复核缺失事实、用途与响应责任人。

预期结果: 本地记录请求，不发送邮件；收到响应后回到证据复核。

SRC-007 · M2.5 · M3.2–M3.3 / SRC-010 §6 · 设计假设 + 合成记录 · J-M3-02, J-M3-03

04 · SCN-VALIDATE · S2 · M3.4–M3.5
按用途评估证据
Current

接收并核验证据，维护剩余缺口与来源记录。

Target

分开保存资料与用途评估；收到补充资料后仍须独立复核。

等待 / 输入: 等待收到补充资料，以及针对筛查用途的充分性理由。

人工边界: 配置的演示复核角色记录充分性及理由；银行权限仍未确认。

预期结果: 完成证据用途评估；筛查仍须独立人工处置。

SRC-007 · M3.4–M3.5 / SRC-010 §6 · 设计假设 + 合成记录 · J-M3-04

05 · SCN-MATCH · S3 · M4.5–M4.7
处理疑似筛查命中
Current

处置疑似命中、判断重大性并记录筛查结果。

Target

整理主体与记录的逐项对照及证据用途；由人工记录处置或请求更多信息。

等待 / 输入: 等待当前充分证据、理由及明确演示权限；相似性不等于决定。

人工边界: 仅演示复核角色可记录处置；不自主批准，也不自动触发 EDD。

预期结果: 仅对该输入版本完成本项处置；法务、信贷与最终 QA 仍未闭合。

SRC-007 · M4.5–M4.7 / SRC-010 §6 · 设计假设 + 合成记录 · SCN-MATCH

06 · SCN-READINESS · S5 · M8.1
明确还剩哪些条件
Current

核对所有适用准入前置条件是否完成。

Target

依据明确条件计算版本化快照；每项保留责任人、理由和下一步。

等待 / 输入: 等待协议执行、信贷条件、QA 复核及所有未知适用性。

人工边界: 未配置银行最终授权；发布及真实交易不属于本切片。

预期结果: 未就绪是可解释结果，而非百分比；授权确认与发布保持独立。

SRC-007 · M8.1 / SRC-010 §6 · 设计假设 + 合成记录 · SCN-READINESS

其余旅程结构

SCN-ENTITY / M1 · M3.4 — 确认主体与代表权限 · Round A 未制作完整交互

SCN-POPULATION / M4.1–M4.4 — 明确筛查群体 · Round A 未制作完整交互

SCN-EDD / M5 — 按适用性进入 EDD · Round A 未制作完整交互

SCN-QA / M6 — 关闭具体质量缺口 · Round A 未制作完整交互

SCN-CONFLICTS / M1 → M7 — 尽早启动利益冲突检查 · Round A 未制作完整交互

SCN-LEGAL / C1 — 完成适用协议 · Round A 未制作完整交互

SCN-CREDIT / C2 — 解决信贷条件 · Round A 未制作完整交互

SCN-PUBLISH / M8.2–M8.5 — 发布有范围的结果 · Round A 未制作完整交互
